Bukod kay Mayor Joy, dumalo rin sa pulong si District 6 Action Officer Atty. Mark Aldave, Traffic and Transport Management Department Head Dexter Cardenas, Department of Sanitation and Cleanup Works of Quezon City Head Richard Santuile, Zoning Administration Unit Chief Mike Velasco, at Engr. Roylan Swanson ng City Engineering Department.

data.raw_text:
Ilang paglilinaw kaugnay ng popular na pagtingin na “panangga” ang bulubundukin ng Sierra Madre sa mga mga bagyong dumadaan sa Luzon:

Bagama’t nahaharangan ng Sierra Madre ang malakas na hangin na dala ng bagyo, lalong lumalakas at dumarami ang bumabagsak na ulan (sa mga lugar gaya ng Metro Manila) dulot ng banggaan ng bundok at bagyo. Ganunpaman, dapat pa din pangalagaan ang ating mga bulubundukin dahil malaki ang papel nito sa para maiwasan ang mga pagbaha at landslide.

See Bagtasa & Racoma (2023) in the Philippine Journal of Science.

Ganunpaman, dapat pa din pangalagaan ang ating mga bulubundukin dahil malaki ang papel nito sa para maiwasan ang mga pagbaha at landslide. See Bagtasa & Racoma (2023) in the Philippine Journal of Science.
data.english_translation: Some clarifications linking the popular view that “the Sierra Madre’s highlands are mountainous to the storms passing on Luzon: Although the Sierra Madre has blocked the strong winds caused by the storm, the falling rains (in areas such as the Metro Manila) are becoming stronger and more likely by a mountain crash and a hurricane. Ganunpaman, it must still protect our highlands because they play a major role in preventing floods and landscapeslide. See Baa & Racoma (20) in the Philippine Science Journal.

Blasting Works on the R63 between Bhisho and Kei Road
 
Eastern Cape, 10 November October 2025: The South African National Roads Agency SOC Limited (SANRAL) would like to notify road users that blasting will take place on the R63 Section 5 (Km 16) between Bhisho and Kei Road on the 11th of November 2025 between 15h00 and 16h00.
 
The road will be closed for approximately one hour to allow sufficient time for the blasting and cleaning-up operations and to ensure the safety of road users.
